sources.text: PDO since 2011; hard 8-9 kg wheel, at least 60% dry matter and 45% fat in dry matter, noble mould on rind; today thermised Gray-Brown cow milk (historically sheep); ripening days not found in sources read

facts.v: Produced since the 16th century on the Nanos plateau
Intense yellow from the beta-carotene in the milk; small pea-sized holes
